H.3990 (192nd session), An Act granting noncitizen permanent residents in the town of Warwick the right to vote in municipal elections. A local home-rule petition filed by Rep. Whipps and Sen. Comerford at the vote of the town. It was referred to the Joint Committee on Election Laws. The 5/27/2021 date is the first date on the bill history page and is the filing date as read from that page.
